name: timbre
description: The connector for Apple Mail and Claude: instant full-text search of all your mail, safe reading, drafting and filing.
long_description:
Timbre reads Apple Mail's own data on your Mac, so Claude can search every message in milliseconds, including message bodies and attachment names, accent-insensitive.

**Safe by design**
- Hidden text in HTML emails (a common carrier for prompt injection) is removed and reported.
- Sender authenticity (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), look-alike senders and reply-to tricks are flagged.
- Drafts open in Mail for you to review; nothing is ever deleted permanently; moves can be undone.
- Sending is off by default; when you turn it on, every message needs an explicit two-step confirmation, with an optional recipient allowlist and an hourly cap.

**Requirements**
- macOS 12 or later with Apple Mail.
- Full Disk Access for Timbre (System Settings › Privacy & Security), to read Mail's data. The mail_status tool tells you exactly which file to add.
- Automation permission for Mail, asked by macOS the first time Timbre drafts or files a message.

No network access, no telemetry: your mail never leaves your Mac.

tools.name: search_mail
tools.description: Full-text search over all mail with filters.

tools.name: read_mail
tools.description: Read a message with sender-authenticity warnings; hidden text removed.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Extract the text of an attachment.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment to your Timbre folder.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: New message, reply or forward as a draft in Mail. Never sends.

tools.name: mark_mail
tools.description: Mark read or unread, flag or unflag.

tools.name: move_mail
tools.description: Move to archive, trash or a mailbox, with undo.

tools.name: prepare_send
tools.description: Sending, step 1 (only when sending is enabled).

tools.name: confirm_send
tools.description: Sending, step 2 (only when sending is enabled).

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only search and read: no drafts, no filing, no sending.

allow_send.title: Allow sending email
allow_send.description: Let Claude send messages after a two-step confirmation. Off: drafts only, you press Send in Mail.

send_allowlist.title: Allowed recipients for sending
send_allowlist.description: Comma-separated addresses or @domains Claude may send to. Empty: any recipient.

max_sends_per_hour.title: Maximum messages sent per hour
max_sends_per_hour.description: Hard cap on messages Claude can send in a rolling hour.

excluded_mailboxes.title: Mailboxes skipped by search
excluded_mailboxes.description: Mailbox roles left out of searches and of the full-text index unless asked for: junk, trash, sent, archive…

attachments_dir.title: Attachments folder
attachments_dir.description: The only folder where Timbre saves attachments. Default: Downloads/Timbre.
